Madore","email":"93156843+fmadore@users.noreply.github.com","date":"2026-10-29T05:31:25Z"},"message":"Release v5.0.0: one keyword rule, strict inputs, coded errors, attested releases

Carries over what the AMIRA server already does well, from the comparison of
the two servers (28 October 2026).

Tool contract
- Every search and aggregate requires every word of a keyword, in any order; a
  "quoted phrase" must occur as written; keyword_mode "literal" keeps the old
  single-substring match. Provenance analysis_version is now iwac-research-v3.
- Input schemas are strict: an unknown argument is an error, not an unfiltered
  search. Arguments are capped at 1,000 elements and strings at 2,000 characters.
- Error bodies gain a stable code (invalid_argument, not_found, unavailable,
  data_error) beside the unchanged message.
- Instructions fit 2,048 characters in every mode, citation rule and
  interpretive guardrails first, and name only registered tools.
- The provenance text block is a compact summary (~390 characters instead of
  ~2,350 on multi-subset calls); the full record stays in _meta.
- Pages stop at ~40,000 characters (response_limited, exact next_offset); a
  filtered list that matches nothing carries a hint, and the article,
  publication and reference searches suggest close subject and newspaper values.
- explore_corpus link: true returns an iwac://export/... resource link holding
  the whole selection (up to 5,000 items).
- IWAC_TOOL_PROFILE (full, core, analysis, search); search, fetch and
  get_collection_stats carry anthropic/alwaysLoad; the title is no longer
  repeated in annotations. Footprint 15,968 -> 15,685 tokens.
- Loopback browser origins reach the HTTP endpoint without an allowlist entry.
- iwac_research completes its depth argument.

CI and releases
- Build-provenance attestations for the bundles, skill zip, server.json and
  image; the Docker base is pinned by digest and kept current by Dependabot.
- Runtime dependency audit, the built bundle on Node 26 and the declared floor,
  timeouts on every job, and the MCP conformance suite behind a token proxy
  with a fixture-only baseline (exit 0 locally).
- Property-based tests (fast-check) on folding, excerpts, keyword terms and
  table-of-contents matching; tests for every contract change above.
- npm run set-version, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, issue and PR templates,
